subject: คณิตศาสตร์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: Radical axis of diameter circles locates a cevian intersection on a median
units.statement: In an acute triangle ABC, let D∈AC and E∈AB, with P=BD∩CE. If the circles with diameters BD and CE meet at S,T and A,S,T are collinear, then power(A,BD)=AB·AD cos A equals power(A,CE)=AC·AE cos A. Since cos A>0, AD/AC=AE/AB=t. Thus DE∥BC, P lies on the A-median, and if the altitude from A is h, the height of P above BC is h(1−t)/(1+t).
steps: Compute power of A to each diameter circle using the endpoint dot product
Use the radical axis through A to equate the two side ratios
Intersect the cevians with a median to find P's height
